description.value: Grafton Agricultural Commons, also known as Grafton Gardens, is a community garden operated by the Bowen Island Food Resilience Society, a local organization focused on food security and sustainable agriculture. The site is freely accessible to the public with no entry fee, making it a pleasant stop for cyclists passing through the area. As a working community garden, it offers a glimpse into local food production and community life.
